description: This source file defines the MacNodeLocationService class, which provides asynchronous location services for macOS using CoreLocation. It manages location requests with timeout handling, delegate methods, and error propagation.

classes.name: MacNodeLocationService
classes.description: A final class managing location updates asynchronously with timeout handling, conforming to CLLocationManagerDelegate and LocationServiceCommon.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with specified accuracy, maximum age, and timeout.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Runs an async operation with a specified timeout, canceling if the timeout is exceeded.
